caption: The overlap is the 400 users who both use UPI and shop online; 200 use UPI only and 100 shop online only, and 300 do neither, giving 1000 users. So P(B|A) = 400/600 = 0.667 while P(B) = 0.50, and the two habits are not independent.

spec.aria: A Venn diagram of 1000 users: 400 use UPI and shop online, 200 use UPI only, 100 shop online only, and 300 do neither.
